description: Read one page of stored posts from a Synoptic stream, newest first. Without sign-in, returns a delayed preview of an active public stream with API access and no custom targets: the latest posts (default and maximum 50), 10 seconds behind realtime, without paging or date bounds; other streams need sign-in. Signed in with permission to read its posts, returns up to 50 posts with an optional continuation token; custom-target restrictions apply. Use date bounds for historical updates or search_stream_posts for text queries. This call reads existing content and does not start monitoring or fetch external sources.

fromDate.description: Inclusive lower bound on post createdAt, as ISO 8601 with a timezone

id.description: Synoptic stream ID from search or streams_all

limit.description: Maximum number of posts in this page; defaults to 10, or 50 without sign-in

nextToken.description: Opaque token from the previous page; keep the stream and date bounds unchanged

toDate.description: Inclusive upper bound on post createdAt, as ISO 8601 with a timezone

name: get_stream_posts

delaySeconds.description: Seconds the posts lag behind realtime; present only for the preview without sign-in

items.description: Stored posts in this page, newest first

nextToken.description: Continuation token for older posts; omitted when this query has no further page

notice.description: Preview limits and how to get realtime posts; present only without sign-in

title: Read stream posts
